description: The createValueRange() for form elements, such as <textarea> or <input type="text">, gets an OpaqueRange object that represents a live span of text. You can use this for range-based operations on the input text, such as setting custom highlights or placing autocomplete popovers.
description_html: The createValueRange() for form elements, such as <textarea> or <input type="text">, gets an OpaqueRange object that represents a live span of text. You can use this for range-based operations on the input text, such as setting custom highlights or placing autocomplete popovers.
name: OpaqueRange

useCases.description: I have a personal tasks and notes management web application I work on, where notes are added and edited in `<textarea>` elements whose contents are rendered using Markdown syntax. This includes some wikimedia-inspired customisation such as creating links to other pages using `[[identifier]]` syntax. I'd like to be able to place an autocomplete hint dropdown, or similar UI, at the caret position when one of these custom links is being written.
